sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The Faithful One (信心深き者, deeply devoted person) of the Bottomless Hole is an old pious woman found praying right before the gate to Ashina Depths, urging Wolf to throw himself down the chasm.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Bottomless Hole: a few steps ahead of the Sculptor's Idol, in front of the torii.

sections.heading: Abandoned Dungeon (Bottomless Hole)
sections.text: Talk to her to receive a hint on how to progress through the area, unlocking the "Ask about the bottomless hole" dialogue when talking "About the stone" with Kuro.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
First encounter | Faithful One: Will you be cast out? Or throw yourself in?
Wolf: What...?
Faithful One: If you wish to go to the very depths of Ashina... Then you'd best cast yourself out. Over there. The depths of Ashina are over there...
Speaking again | Faithful One: Will you be cast out? Or throw yourself in?
